Before you ask.
It's used as a risk signal for high-trust roles, never as a label. Results are restricted to trained reviewers and the report frames elevated scores as areas to probe in the interview.
Machiavellianism, narcissism and psychopathy on a normed scale, reported as low, moderate or elevated relative to a working population.
Access is role-restricted and audited. Hiring managers see a summary risk view; the full breakdown stays with the assessment owner.
Validation and reliability are specific to the assessment, version and reference population. Request the technical documentation for your selected instrument, including the applicable reliability measure, norm sample and validity evidence. Illustrative report figures are not validation evidence.
Yes for the major platforms Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, SmartRecruiters, iCIMS, Ashby and others through native sync or API. Anything custom is handled with a webhook or scheduled sync.
Data stays inside your account and is never used to train models outside it. Xobin is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified, with GDPR-aligned data processing and configurable retention.
